cua-driver-rs-v0.59.5cua-driver-rs: v0.59.5 Prerelease2026-11-23T14:49:26Z

Cua Driver 0.59.5

Summary

This release includes 3 fixes.

Fixes

  • give the + route in the macOS permission guides. (#8572)
  • draw no agent cursor for a human viewer's desktop click on Wayland. (#8581)
  • match executable grants only on the attested process image. (#8584) reported by @soarkit.

Contributors

Thanks to @soarkit for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.59.4-nightly.20261123.45111568675 Prerelease2026-11-23T05:41:37Z

Cua Driver 0.59.4-nightly.20261123.45111568675 (nightly)

Automated immutable nightly built from an exact main commit. Nightlies are opt-in, may be less stable than regular releases, and never replace stable update discovery.

Source

  • Commit: f78bd08cde7b8c52857c3802233b3d023549dfed
  • Changes: nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.58.1-nightly.20261122.44984672738…f78bd08cde7b

Changes

  • Fix: keep the macOS agent cursor under a window covering its background target. (#8511) reported by @r33drichards.
  • Fix: raise the agent cursor after an untargeted move that follows a click. (#8521) reported by @Neonotso.
  • Fix: keep foreground type_text out of sibling windows. (#8515) reported by @dannote.
  • Feat: add metadata-only RuntimeWitnessV0 contract. (#7952) Thanks @hippoley.
  • Fix: answer sent messages while attached to the target input queue on Windows. (#8522)
  • Fix: tell apps how many wheel clicks a Hyprland scroll was. (#8351) Thanks @somtooo.
  • Fix: wait for a woken Chromium AT-SPI tree before the first Linux walk. (#7886) reported by @BlankParticle.
  • Fix: refuse macOS clicks on controls behind an attached sheet. (#7798) Thanks @muness.
  • Fix: report foregrounded_window when Chrome comes forward during existing-profile attach. (#7884) reported by @seiyaiwaoka-CR.
  • Fix: do not retype a Gecko web write whose AXValue is unreadable. (#8557) reported by @WaveringAna.
  • Fix: confirm dom_event browser clicks from the page changes their handlers cause. (#8138)
  • Fix: attach to the Windows input queue only after the target processed its activation. (#8550)
  • Fix: isolate semantic AX lookups by renderer target. (#8153) Thanks @Iflaqbhat; reported by @jacklau04.

Contributors

Thanks to @BlankParticle, @dannote, @hippoley, @Iflaqbhat, @jacklau04, @muness, @Neonotso, @r33drichards, @seiyaiwaoka-CR, @somtooo, @WaveringAna for contributing to or reporting changes in this nightly.

Exact installation

CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION=nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.59.4-nightly.20261123.45111568675 /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

cua-driver-rs-v0.59.3cua-driver-rs: v0.59.3 Prerelease2026-11-23T02:08:40Z

Cua Driver 0.59.3

Summary

This release includes 4 fixes.

Fixes

  • report foregrounded_window when Chrome comes forward during existing-profile attach. (#7884) reported by @seiyaiwaoka-CR.
  • do not retype a Gecko web write whose AXValue is unreadable. (#8557) reported by @WaveringAna.
  • confirm dom_event browser clicks from the page changes their handlers cause. (#8138)
  • attach to the Windows input queue only after the target processed its activation. (#8550)

Contributors

Thanks to @seiyaiwaoka-CR, @WaveringAna for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-driver-rs-v0.59.0cua-driver-rs: v0.59.0 Prerelease2026-11-22T15:39:12Z

Cua Driver 0.59.0

Summary

This release adds 1 feature.

Features

  • add metadata-only RuntimeWitnessV0 contract. (#7952) Thanks @hippoley.

Contributors

Thanks to @hippoley for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

tw93/Pake ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
V3.21.0V3.21.0 Doorway Stable2026-11-23T14:33:19Z

<div align="center"> <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Pake/main/assets/logo.png" alt="Pake Logo" width="120" height="120" style="border-radius:50%" /> <h1 style="margin: 12px 0 6px;">Pake V3.21.0</h1> <p><em>Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.</em></p> </div>

Changelog

  1. A link in a mail to another site's sign-in page, such as github.com/login or a /auth/verify link, now opens in the default browser instead of replacing the page, as it did in an Outlook web mail app. A site's own sign-in still stays in the app.
  2. A Cmd-click on macOS, a Ctrl-click on Windows and Linux, or a middle-click opens the link in the default browser, as in a browser.
  3. Ctrl+Shift+H and the Home menu item leave a window the page opened alone, so a sign-in popup is never sent to the app's home page halfway through.
  4. The runtime moves to Tauri 2.12.7, Wry 0.57.3 and url 2.5.9, which fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0592, where a nested blob: address could abort an app while downloading.
  5. The CLI now needs Node.js 22.12 or later.

更新日志

  1. 邮件里指向别的网站登录页的链接，比如 github.com/login 或 /auth/verify 这类，现在会在默认浏览器里打开，不再像之前在 Outlook 网页邮箱应用里那样把页面整个换掉，网站自己的登录还是留在应用里。
  2. macOS 上按住 Command 点、Windows 和 Linux 上按住 Ctrl 点，或者用中键点链接，会和浏览器一样在默认浏览器里打开。
  3. Ctrl+Shift+H 和菜单里的回到首页不再作用于网页自己打开的窗口，登录弹窗不会在登录到一半时被带回应用首页。
  4. 运行时升到 Tauri 2.12.7、Wry 0.57.3 和 url 2.5.9，修复了 RUSTSEC-2026-0592，之前嵌套的 blob: 地址可能在下载时让应用直接退出。
  5. CLI 现在需要 Node.js 22.12 或更高版本。

If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends.

Pake App

If you would rather click than type commands, Pake App makes apps from a ready-made gallery or any URL on Mac, Windows and Linux, with no Node.js or Rust to install, and adds ad blocking and updates for the apps you made. You can download it here. The CLI stays free and open source.

Graphify-Labs/graphify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.118 Stable2026-11-23T13:38:45Z

A batch of extractor, resolution, serve, export, clustering and reporting fixes across fourteen community pull requests. The Objective-C, C and C# changes alter node/edge output, so the AST cache schema bumps (51 to 53) and the first build after upgrading re-extracts the affected languages; the other fixes need no rebuild.

  • Fix: csharp a local, parameter or field named partial, required, async, nint, nuint or with (contextual keywords) that tree-sitter-c-sharp mis-parses where a statement starts with it no longer derails the file; it is rewritten to its verbatim @name form before parsing (byte-length preserving), so the enclosing type and the members after it are kept instead of being silently dropped (#5043, thanks @ThatAblaze).
  • Fix: c a call through a struct function-pointer field (ops->run(), ops.run()) no longer fabricates a calls edge to a same-named free function; the field name is no evidence of the pointer's runtime target, so the guess is dropped. A plain direct call still resolves (#5410, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
  • Fix: objc an Objective-C method whose name folds onto a sibling's id within one @interface/@implementation/@protocol (a leading/trailing _ as in -setup/-_setup, or a case-only difference) gets its own salted node id instead of overwriting it; the declaration and definition of one method still share a single node (#5390, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: go a struct field's owner type is scoped to its own package, so a field of a type whose name is declared in two packages binds to the right one and its member calls resolve instead of being dropped as ambiguous (#5408, thanks @azizur100389).
  • Fix: extract a Svelte import that comes through an export * barrel now resolves to the real defining module, matching plain .ts. The cross-file resolver was masking .vue but not .svelte, so the Svelte <script> imports were lost to a template parse error; chained barrels resolve and ambiguous re-exports fail closed. Run graphify extract . --force once to repair an already-cached graph (#5403, thanks @Max17190).
  • Fix: extract audio and video files that are detected but not extracted (headless extract has no transcription step) are now reported in the summary instead of silently vanishing, matching the other skip notices; no nodes are fabricated for them (#5076, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: sections get_section's retry no longer reuses the full graph's trigram search index. The retry ran against a networkx subgraph view whose .graph dict is the same object serve caches the index on, so the retry searched stale, out-of-section ids and raised KeyError; the retry view now gets its own graph metadata, which also removes a shared-graph index-corruption hazard for concurrent serve callers (#5385, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Fix: serve the MCP server loads graph.json off the event loop, so a large graph reload no longer blocks concurrent requests; a request during a reload is served the current graph and a corrupt reload leaves the old graph intact (#5371, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Fix: update a clustered GRAPH_REPORT.md that is deleted while the graph is otherwise unchanged is regenerated instead of being skipped by the no-change gate; the graph itself is left byte-identical (restored from the partition cache) so there is no needless rebuild (#5402, thanks @Max17190).
  • Fix: query image nodes are demoted in seed scoring alongside documents and papers, so a caption-rich image no longer out-seeds real code for a query whose terms it happens to repeat (#445, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: export export filenames honor the target filesystem's NAME_MAX (probed via pathconf, not assumed to be 255), so graphify export obsidian/wiki/canvas no longer aborts with ENAMETOOLONG on filesystems that report a lower limit such as eCryptfs (143); long names are truncated with a hash suffix and internal links use the shortened names (#2109, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: wiki directed-graph exports now include incoming edges, so a community audit no longer under-reports confidence (an incoming AMBIGUOUS edge could be invisible while the page read "EXTRACTED 100%"). On god-node pages incoming edges are marked (incoming) so a relation like calls is not read backwards (#5369, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
  • Fix: config .graphifyrc now parses demote_docs / query_demote_docs, so a project can set doc demotion in the rcfile instead of only via the CLI flag; an explicit flag still overrides it (#5290, thanks @debojyoti10CC).
  • Perf: cluster community-overlap counting during a rebuild is computed from shared nodes in one pass instead of intersecting every pair of communities, turning an O(communities squared) step into a linear one with byte-identical results (#5382, thanks @Max17190).

View release →

longbridge/gpui-kit ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.11.0 Stable2026-11-23T12:56:30Z

GPUI Kit v0.11.0

GPUI Kit 0.11.0 is a minor release. It moves to gpui-pre 0.3.14 and GPUI Fast 0.1.19, makes the Linux X11 backend an optional default feature, replaces chrono with jiff in the date and time components, and brings a long run of editor, Markdown, diff and accessibility work. The X11 feature, the jiff types and the upstream GPUI API changes are breaking, so this is a minor release.

Breaking Changes

  • Linux X11 is a feature: gpui-kit/x11 is now a default feature. Apps that turn off the defaults and still run on X11 must ask for it; Wayland-only apps no longer link libxkbcommon-x11. (#4060)
    - gpui-kit = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
+ gpui-kit = { version = "0.11", default-features = false, features = ["x11"] }
  • Calendar, DatePicker, TimeField use jiff: Date, Matcher, CalendarState and TimeFieldState take jiff::civil::Date / Time instead of chrono types, so cargo deny no longer flags the unmaintained chrono (RUSTSEC-2026-0543). Format strings are unchanged. (#4015)
  • Upstream GPUI: gpui-pre now also gives every Element a blanket IntoElement, so drop your own impl IntoElement on element types on both backends. Path is no longer generic, WindowBounds::centered takes Option<DisplayId>, and FillOptions::tolerance is gone. (#4092)

New APIs

  • Input: a suggestion list under the field like <input list>; public fold_all, unfold_all, fold_at_level and set_folded. (#3785, #4028)
  • Editor: GutterStyle for the line-number gap, color and font; show the active line only while focused. (#3737, #4067)
  • Diff: span_highlights for character spans, the character under the pointer for hosting links, and partial files at their own line numbers. (#4011, #4042, #4043)
  • Components: resizable handle drag state, SelectableText range reveal, a left-side vertical scrollbar, and a DockSkin option to hide the resting split divider. (#4039, #4052, #4078, #4084)
  • Shell: PluginManager::with_host_module. (#3948)

Editor and text input

  • Faster soft wrap for large and non-ASCII documents; f64 vertical coordinates past 2^24 px and 9-digit line numbers; clip text to its side of the gutter. (#3974, #4022, #4077)
  • End IME composition on blur, redact IME surrounding text in masked inputs, report the document length so the iOS keyboard shows. (#4032, #4059, #4082)
  • Ctrl+Delete stops at white space and line breaks; a single-line input drops tabs like newlines; each paragraph of a text area starts at the edge it reads from; the input text takes the theme foreground. (#4034, #4071, #4016, #4051)
  • Less accessibility text-run memory on large documents. (#4090)

Markdown and text rendering

  • Inline flows lay out once in a shrinking bubble and wrap without rescanning the paragraph; inline-code paragraphs keep their text between frames; closing marks stay on the word's line. (#4029, #4058, #4063, #4087)
  • Show Markdown as plain text if the parser panics; stop sweeping retained layouts that are all alive; select a wrapped row's first character; share linked-image clicks; expose the rendered body to the accessibility tree. (#4013, #4000, #4012, #4053, #4056, #4054)
  • Highlighter injection layers follow the caller's parse timeout. (#4074)

Components

  • Diff: file headers and annotation cards stay in the viewport while scrolling horizontally. (#3996, #4009)
  • Dialog, Notification, Popover, Root: the backdrop stays inside the client frame; notifications sit above modal layers; a controlled popover moves focus after the frame; Tab works before anything is focused. (#4049, #3577, #4023, #4017)
  • Menu, Scrollbar, Table, Tabs, Resizable: no scrollbar on a menu that fits; only the primary button drags the track; set_selected_* no longer scrolls; Tabs focus on pointer down; resizing skips hidden panels. (#4014, #4038, #4046, #4002, #4064)
  • Title bar, Kbd, Motion, Icon, Button: follow Linux window button layouts; shifted-symbol shortcuts on Windows; a closed Presence reports Absent; warn once for a missing icon path; expose the expanded state. (#4018, #3993, #4062, #4075, #4035)
  • WebView: no gaps at fractional sizes on macOS, clip partly visible WebViews on Windows. (#4065, #4066)

Docs and tooling

  • A Claude Code plugin for the GPUI Kit skills, fixed guide links in the standalone skills, a fuller zh-CN List guide, and the right canvas size for web examples in Firefox. (#4089, #4088, #4030, #4045, #4048, #4047)

Dependencies

  • gpui-pre 0.3.14 and GPUI Fast 0.1.19 (via 0.1.17); chrono replaced by jiff 1.0; Cargo.lock updated for 8 RustSec advisories; unused anyhow removed. (#4027, #4092, #4015, #4080, #4081)

v2026.11.10-beta.2openclaw 2026.11.10-beta.2 Prerelease2026-11-23T12:48:59Z

2026.11.10-beta.2

Highlights

  • Update recovery: keep OpenClaw runnable when package replacement is interrupted, and let the next update finish safely after a crash or reboot. (#200273, #200366, #200460, #200550, #200994) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable background work: preserve finished subagent results and resume their delivery after Gateway restarts, interrupted parent turns, and sibling activity. (#200279, #200649, #200249, #201544, #201563) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.
  • Faster first conversations: accept the first chat while model catalogs load, keep readiness checks responsive, and compact long histories without holding them entirely in Gateway memory. (#201127, #200370, #201304) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @garrytan.

Changes

  • Agent templates: open a durable chat before verified setup finishes, while retaining rollback authorization for newly created agents. (#196392, #200300) Related #196048 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @anmol0b.
  • Plugin side questions: let plugins fork a session’s live context for background work with their own tools and policy-controlled file and command access. (#170146, #190950, #200636) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Webhooks: accept bodies up to 1 MiB, report rejected requests, and fan out batched Gmail notifications. (#200514, #130002) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Secret-backed skill keys: preserve SecretRef values when keys are edited through the Skills page or skills.update instead of replacing references with plaintext. (#200539, #197319) Related #193149 Thanks @obviyus, @tommyjoseph, and @mmaps.

  • Permission boundaries: retain the admitted requester’s authority across restart recovery and native UI clients, and keep queued input from ending without a recorded cause. (#200394, #181363, #194443, #200433) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, @sallyom, @VACInc, and @obviyus.

  • Chat delivery: finish replies interrupted by Gateway restarts, preserve channel message IDs on oversized history entries, and reject stale-pane sends after a conversation branch switches. (#200553, #201698, #113073) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.

  • Subagent conversations: deliver completed results while siblings are still running or waiting, preserve each result under its requester turn, and stop sessions_send from blocking beyond its timeout. (#190999, #200967, #200873, #201373) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @obviyus, and @esqandil.

  • Live steering: deliver new instructions to busy subagents immediately, keep background turns running through configuration edits, and allow steering while a Code Mode command is active. (#200574, #200516, #200998) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @VACInc.

  • Automation continuity: retain scheduled work when chats, groups, or sharing change, preserve owner/account bindings across handoffs, and keep carried-over jobs running after updates. (#200314, #200396, #201434, #201008, #200653) Related #200307, #200600 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @hannesrudolph, @obviyus, @daniel-lxs, and @VACInc.

  • Automation outcomes: distinguish recovered tool errors, genuine tool failures, and successfully delivered reports; suppress notices for expected skips rather than reporting them as failed starts. (#201638, #107735, #139037, #120056, #152165, #186652, #194276, #200032) Related #102206, #116731, #194261, #200030 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @joshavant, @solavrc, @hartmark, @NarahariRaghava, @warren2008-2020-spec, @pash-openai, @wr-web, @slatem, and @daniel-lxs.

  • Telegram: keep receiving messages when update IDs restart, and answer messages even when an attachment cannot be downloaded. (#201167, #200682) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.

  • Discord and WhatsApp: reconnect all Discord accounts after network outages, preserve independent requests instead of replacing active tasks, and avoid flooding sessions with WhatsApp reconnect notices. (#201415, #201518, #191037) Related #162189, #190640 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @ericcurtin, and @sercada.

  • Matrix and Slack: prevent quoted bot mentions from starting new Matrix turns, render Matrix polls and votes in Element X, and retain Slack questions when an unauthorized person presses a button. (#197091, #191700, #201371) Related #197065, #191678, #201348 Thanks @Jo2234, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, and @shannon0430.

  • Media and meetings: expose inbound Twilio MMS photos to agents, retain long Feishu streaming replies, and keep meeting audio and captions alive after a join request returns. (#200890, #161777, #191059, #178415) Related #200804, #139443, #173896, #178413 Thanks @deepujain, @obviyus, @potterdigital, @ArthurNie, @Simon2256928, @valkyriweb, @jeremynorris, and @sukhdeepjohar.

  • Talk and mobile: load conversation history for fresh calls, keep iOS spoken replies beside the turn that prompted them, and avoid stale roles in approval alerts. (#201352, #197136, #200360) Related #197129 Thanks @davelutztx, @xena68, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @joshavant.

  • Claude CLI: retain final answers after progress and large tool results, avoid redoing completed tool work on fallback, and preserve long child results in completion turns. (#200501, #166127, #200801, #200470, #200226) Related #186967, #200744, #199633 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @Trinity-AI-Coder, @RTapiador, @fede-kamel, @jzmudzinski, @chaeyn, @etzelm, @VACInc, and @mulderp82.

  • Codex conversations: preserve instructions and oversized request content, recover media-only turns, avoid MCP name collisions, and retain line breaks in streamed replies. (#200690, #200735, #185186, #194831, #201102) Related #185079, #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @kaguranananana, @UHDPass, @lonexreb, @NicoBoom13, and @freeqaz.

  • Model discovery: discover new ChatGPT subscription models independently of npm releases, use published catalog limits, retain account reasoning limits, and keep healthy fallback models available. (#201130, #201493, #200403, #200446, #200946) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @VACInc.

  • Tool access: show required arguments for wide schemas and initial Knowledge tools, preserve full Tool Search pages, validate compact-tool arguments, and leave an empty tools.allow unrestricted. (#200064, #200339, #201487, #114461, #197590) Related #194857, #96115, #111704, #197552 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @lyrakat, @cbertucci33, @pallaoro, @wr-web, and @primepal2.

  • Browser control: keep page reads attached to the correct page after navigation, preserve the user’s focused Chrome tab, and allow screenshots of background tabs in headless mode. (#196659, #134400, #201626) Related #196658 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @martins-oss, @obviyus, and @scotthuang.

  • Install and update: tolerate concurrent database writers, preserve completed core updates when plugin or service refreshes need retrying, and finish when unchanged plugin configuration is read-only. (#200742, #201545, #201330, #200507, #200331, #201331) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.

  • Older installations: bridge older updater layouts, preserve valid archives, recover interrupted source-checkout updates, and retain package installs when an old wrapper cannot be removed. (#200662, #201314, #200659, #200733, #201009, #200579) Related #200594 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @SimonAIbot, and @fuller-stack-dev.

  • Linux and Windows updates: avoid RAM-backed temporary-directory exhaustion when TMPDIR is unset, accept pre-existing service drop-ins, validate staged Windows plugin dependencies, and redact Windows home paths from Doctor failure reports. (#199689, #197378, #200595, #200457) Related #197377, #200573, #200451 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kitiyeung, @holgergruenhagen, @sallyom, @desksk, and @LolPanda2004.

  • Storage recovery: preserve PostgreSQL startup and backup restore paths, allow supported moves between SQLite and PostgreSQL, and speed up network database ports. (#197425, #193596, #197795, #200383, #201299, #201374) Related #196966, #197779, #200356, #201250, #201249 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ceckert, @VACInc, @etzelm, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, and @deepujain.

  • History and responsiveness: reduce stalls in transcript searches, sparse-history reads, filesystem-heavy work, plugin reload recovery, and background page cleanup. (#200355, #201566, #200793, #197510, #200320, #200374, #201445) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc and @RomneyDa.

  • Desktop startup: let the macOS app answer its first chat and reopen after credential startup failures; finish VNC authentication before readiness probes close. (#200373, #201505, #193487) Related #200340, #193444 Thanks @jalehman, @jjjhenriksen, @SebTardif, @obviyus, and @lakemike.

  • Replay timestamps: preserve the original user-turn timestamp across attachment preparation and worker replay. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

  • Setup and authentication: discover cold account models before inference and classify model-route credential mismatches correctly. Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @vincentkoc, and @DanCanadian.

  • Update diagnostics: retain nested handoff failure details and distinguish snapshot capacity failures from database corruption. Thanks @qodelicious, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @machine3at.

v2026.11.7openclaw 2026.11.7 Stable2026-11-23T01:33:51Z

2026.11.7

Highlights

  • Conversation recovery: Recover interrupted replies and child results across Gateway restarts without losing pending work. (#198905, #201544, #200924, #200967) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @galiniliev, and @vincentkoc.
  • Reliable automations: Let an automation’s owner conversation repair failures, and distinguish recovered or intentionally skipped runs from genuine failures. (#161007, #201638, #152165, #194276) Related #194261 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @pash-openai, @wr-web, and @slatem.
  • Smoother updates: Finish Git and package updates through schema changes, busy databases, and retained recovery state instead of stopping before or after the new release starts. (#201600, #201463, #201545, #201330) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Responsive Gateway: Keep chats, readiness checks, and unrelated sessions responsive during slow filesystem operations, large recovery packs, and page extraction. (#191236, #201248, #200623, #200925) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Browser pairing: Pair another browser with a short code approved on the Gateway host, with clearer instructions while approval is pending. (#191513, #200905) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @jalehman, and @etzelm.
  • Current ChatGPT catalogs: Discover newly available subscription models without waiting for another OpenClaw release and keep sign-in discovery independent of npm. (#201130, #201493) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @daniel-lxs.

Changes

  • Knowledge search: Find current records using superseded wording and match canonically equivalent Unicode keyword spellings. (#193742, #195092) Related #193054, #195031 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @Linux2010, @jalehman, and @saariuslystoned.
  • Talk transcription: Use a saved Deepgram, ElevenLabs, or Mistral API key for live transcription. (#199858) Related #199684 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Session control — breaking SDK change: Move session-keyed setActiveEmbeddedRun(...) registrations into the host-provided runAttempt callback and retain their exact cleanup function; unadmitted registration now reports SESSION_CONTROLLER_ADMISSION_REQUIRED. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • Gateway methods — breaking SDK change: Replace mutable chatAbortControllers and chatQueuedTurns access with dispatchGatewayMethod from openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-method-runtime, declaring contracts.gatewayMethodDispatch: ["authenticated-request"] in the plugin manifest; existing caller permissions still apply. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @johan-eilertsen, and @jalehman.
  • Start observation — breaking SDK change: Update AgentTurnStartOwner.observe() consumers from expiresAtMs to startDeadlineAtMs; this is the execution-start deadline, not the execution timeout, and has no compatibility alias. See docs/plugins/sdk-migration.md for migration guidance. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.

Fixes

  • Reply and command boundaries: Keep slash commands in ordinary prose from executing and warn before retrying a tool action whose reply was lost. (#200458, #201523) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @VACInc.
  • Stop and steering: Answer messages sent after Stop, preserve steering through long-running tools, and let users steer while a Code Mode shell command runs. (#195612, #199878, #200998) Related #194303 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @amittell, @obviyus, and @VACInc.
  • Subagent results: Keep results attached to their requesting turn and prevent one child’s delivery failure from dropping sibling results. (#200873, #201563, #195275) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @VACInc, and @jalehman.
  • Scheduled work: Preserve automation ownership through account, sharing, and group changes, and keep scheduled global work in its existing conversation. (#201008, #201434, #188173) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @jalehman, and @shakkernerd.
  • Claude CLI: Retain final answers after progress messages, include long child results in completion turns, and show tool history with a custom Claude configuration directory. (#200470, #200226, #198337) Related #199633 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @chaeyn, @obviyus, @etzelm, @VACInc, @mulderp82, @xiaoguomeiyitian, and @Szqub.
  • Codex: Keep resumed conversations on the same native writer, distinguish API quota from subscription exhaustion, and preserve line breaks in streamed replies. (#201474, #192165, #201102) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @TheRealUnknownSoldier, @VACInc, and @freeqaz.
  • Model and credential recovery: Keep shared OAuth refresh with the running Gateway, use ambient AWS credentials for Bedrock Mantle, and report why a listed model rejects a request. (#198214, #190988, #200073) Related #163006 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @netcrazed.
  • Compaction: Use configured fallbacks after quota errors, avoid false post-compaction stall aborts, and preserve selected skills in sandboxed sessions. (#194813, #194722, #198029) Related #194803, #194715 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @VACInc, @saariuslystoned, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jason-allen-oneal, and @obviyus.
  • Telegram: Finish large media uploads, retain callback controls when replacement delivery fails, and answer messages even when their attachment cannot download. (#151923, #193948, #200682) Related #193947 Thanks @RomneyDa, @amittell, @obviyus, and @AmelioMansour.
  • Discord and Slack: Reconnect all Discord accounts after outages, keep independent requests from replacing active tasks, and keep top-level Slack completions top-level. (#201415, #201518, #187065) Related #162189 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @vincentkoc, and @wr-web.
  • Matrix and Feishu: Preserve image captions and reply placement, show Matrix polls and votes in Element X, and finish long Feishu replies in the same streaming card. (#188018, #191700, #161777) Related #188038, #191678, #139443 Thanks @seriouslysean, @thatsrue, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.
  • Voice calls: Avoid raw JSON and truncated long answers, ignore echoed caller transcripts, and answer when background noise prevents endpointing. (#151367, #191537, #191498) Thanks @Weiming-Hu, @weiming, @obviyus, and @mnowrot.
  • Mobile and macOS: Start a new Android chat while a response is running, accept native Talk setups, and let the macOS app answer its first chat without a false low-memory refusal. (#191372, #191194, #200373) Related #191339, #200340 Thanks @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @saariuslystoned, @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, and @jalehman.
  • Browser tools: Keep the user’s Chrome tab focused, read text from the correct page after navigation, and capture background tabs in headless mode. (#134400, #196659, #201626) Related #196658 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @scotthuang, @martins-oss, and @obviyus.
  • Control UI: Preserve dictation while microphone permission is pending, show transcription progress, and recover connections promptly after returning to the app. (#199069, #200235, #199887) Related #199065, #199875 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @daniel-lxs.
  • Fast navigation: Open Channels and Devices without waiting for unrelated Chat or configuration work, and open Knowledge Browse without scanning unrelated stores. (#194393, #194795, #194792) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Configuration and Doctor: Preserve guarded writes through symlinked state roots, restore reported truncated configuration, and avoid unrelated system Gateways blocking migrations. (#155538, #201501, #190194) Related #190177 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @mfurkanakinci, @vincentkoc, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Backups and PostgreSQL: Allow scheduled backups beyond ten minutes, protect verification from concurrent cleanup, restore through symlinked targets, and finish network database ports without hours of avoidable waiting. (#191346, #198659, #197795, #201374) Related #197779, #201249 Thanks @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @vincentkoc, @chelsealong, @etzelm, @deepujain, and @evemorgen.
  • Update reporting and recovery: Preserve warnings and accurate elapsed time, avoid asking owners to retry an update already running, and recover interrupted conversation state. (#194242, #194289, #188159) Related #188149 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @shakkernerd.
  • Installation and plugins: Install local file URLs on Windows, stage native dependencies when execution is denied, and keep Git installs working while Node is being provisioned. (#190734, #193801, #195382) Related #195366 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @AmelioMansour, @wr-web, and @okbilinmeyen7komut-alt.
  • Memory and knowledge: Recover indexing after embedding timeouts, support configured local Ollama hostnames, and recover interrupted Knowledge writes without duplicating repair work. (#191556, #191479, #193116, #198146) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @galiniliev, @Finn763, @triciah73, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
  • Sandbox and templates: Keep turns working after the default sandbox image changes, avoid unrelated workspace contention, and allow retries after partially written template creation. (#193986, #197561, #199447) Related #193964 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @karam2022, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @obviyus.
  • Files and paths: Handle Markdown carriage-return line endings, dotfiles and consecutive dots, and multiline frontmatter without losing text. (#200783, #197398, #199739, #198439) Related #200757 Thanks @RomneyDa, @LinzeShi, and @obviyus.
  • Retained work: Restore retained downloads after worker reclaim, keep recently used worktrees out of idle cleanup, and preserve reconciled files during fast-forward. (#198102, #201333, #137942) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @joshavant, and @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • Long text pastes: retain long pasted text in the composer as user text rather than automatically converting it into an attachment. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Usage reporting: distinguish historical usage from live inference cost rather than presenting missing historical cost as a measured zero. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Bundled Codex alignment: align the ACP Codex override with the bundled 0.170.0 runtime while retaining ACP 2.2.2. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Provider hooks: preserve installed agent and plugin transport hooks when the SDK loads later, instead of replacing them with inactive defaults. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.40CC Switch v4.0.40 Stable2026-11-23T12:42:26Z

CC Switch v4.0.40

本版本让 Grok Build 的官方卡可以绑定授权中心里的 xAI 账号，像 Claude、Codex 官方卡一样在多个 Grok 账号之间切换。插件页支持 Antigravity CLI；用量统计的供应商和模型列表加了缓存命中率；小米 MiMo 内置余额和 Token Plan 额度查询；授权中心的账号卡片跟随侧栏应用的顺序和隐藏设置。

本版本还加固了深链接导入 MCP、用量脚本、SQL 导入和非本机监听地址的安全检查，并提升了数据库、本地路由、用量同步、会话搜索和「应用」页的速度。另外修复了 Kimi Code Desktop 主 agent 的用量没统计；Antigravity 输出速度从 4.0.38 起虚高；T3 Code 和单独运行的 ACP 里的 Antigravity 会话看不到；Mistral 官方 API 开思考后回复为空；Kimi 原生 Responses 在并行看图工具调用后一直报 400；WorkBuddy 企业账号积分显示为已用完；托盘里看不到 xAI 额度、官方账号显示成网站域名；Skills 页的「发现」里出现重复的技能；「应用」页要等版本检查完才显示安装状态等问题。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

Grok 官方卡绑定 xAI 账号

Grok Build 的 Grok Official 表单加了「登录方式」（#9321，关闭 #8599），可以选授权中心里的 xAI 账号、添加或管理 xAI 账号，或者「跟随 Grok CLI 登录」，用法和 Claude、Codex 官方卡一样。

  • 每个绑定的账号是一张单独的卡，名字带上账号，可以加任意多张；不绑账号的仍是原来那张固定的卡。
  • 切到绑了账号的卡时，CC Switch 会先刷新这个号的登录，再把它写进 Grok CLI 的 ~/.grok/auth.json，文件里的其他内容不动。Grok CLI 已经登录着这个号时不写；网络暂时失败时提示稍后重试，账号确实失效才提示去授权中心重新登录。
  • 换号前，Grok CLI 当前登录的号会先收进授权中心；切回「跟随 Grok CLI 登录」的卡时，还原成第一次换号前的号。
  • 在授权中心删掉账号时，如果 Grok CLI 正在用的是 CC Switch 替这个号写的登录，会还原原来的登录，原来的号也没了就退出登录。
  • 绑了账号的卡，卡片、用量和托盘的额度都按这个号查。没绑账号的卡在 Grok CLI 的登录过期时，改用授权中心里同一个用户的账号查额度。

Antigravity CLI 插件

「插件」页支持 Antigravity CLI（#9882、#9885），和其他应用一样调用 agy 自己的命令行，可以在「发现」里浏览官方和合作伙伴市场的插件，安装、启用、停用、卸载和更新。

  • 更新前先比对市场上的版本号，已是最新就不重装。
  • 插件被正在运行的 Antigravity 会话或后台服务占用时，提示先关掉再重试。
  • 旧版 Antigravity 应用装的插件放在数字命名的目录里，CC Switch 无法替它更新，会提示卸载后在「发现」里重新安装。

用量统计：按供应商和模型看缓存命中率

用量统计的「供应商」和「模型」列表在 Tokens 后面加了「命中率」一列，能看出是哪家供应商、哪个模型没吃到缓存。算法和请求日志里的命中率一样（缓存命中 ÷ 可缓存输入），各行的缓存命中和可缓存输入加起来与顶部的总数一致；没有可缓存输入的行显示「—」。

小米 MiMo 余额和 Token Plan 额度

小米 MiMo 的供应商内置了两种官方查询（关闭 #9404），不用再靠抓控制台 Cookie 的用量脚本：

  • Token Plan（tp- 开头的 Key）：显示已用和总额度，以及本期结束时间。
  • 余额（sk- 开头的 Key）：显示可用余额（扣除冻结部分），余额为 0 不会被当成 Key 无效。

授权中心卡片跟随侧栏应用

授权中心的账号卡片按「应用」页里拖动的应用顺序排列。只有用到这个账号的应用全都隐藏了，卡片才隐藏（Copilot、ChatGPT、xAI 账号还会被 Claude Code 等应用的供应商用到）；从供应商表单跳过来的那张卡总是显示。

新增预设

新增 StringAI。

变更

  • 数据库与本地路由更快（#9820、#9821）：主数据库改用 WAL 模式，路由每次请求要读的配置、路由、定价和故障转移队列改从缓存读，路由的数据库操作移到单独的线程，不再占住处理请求的线程；转发请求时少复制一次对话内容，没有改写过的请求不再重复跑隐私过滤。
  • 用量同步更快（#9817、#9818）：各应用的会话日志并行扫描；用量脚本在单独的线程里运行，不再拖慢其他请求。
  • 会话内容搜索更快（#9827、#9896）：一两个字的搜索不再扫描全部正文；继续输入时，上一次还没完成的搜索会被取消。搜索索引格式有变，升级后第一次搜索会重建索引。
  • 「应用」页打开更快（#9418、#9886，关闭 #9884）：先按本机的安装路径显示「已安装 / 未安装」分组，不用等每个工具的版本检查；各工具的版本同时检查，查完一个显示一个。

安全

  • 深链接导入 MCP（#9831）：确认框显示 MCP 服务器的全部字段（包括工作目录、请求头等），高危字段标红提示。会读取本机环境变量、执行辅助命令、把工作目录指向网络共享路径，或地址不是 http / https 的配置，直接拒绝导入。
  • 用量脚本（#9829）：脚本发出的请求不再跟随重定向，不能发给 CC Switch 自己的路由端口，响应最多读 2 MiB；填进脚本的 Key、地址等变量会正确转义。深链接里的用量查询地址也会检查，是内网或本机地址时确认框会提示。
  • SQL 导入（#9832）：导入 SQL 备份或 WebDAV / S3 同步快照时，不允许创建触发器和视图，文件最大 512 MiB，执行超过 30 秒即中止。
  • 非本机监听地址的 Host 检查（#9833）：路由服务监听 0.0.0.0 / :: 时，来自本机的请求也要通过防 DNS 重绑定的 Host 检查。

修复

  • Kimi Code Desktop 主 agent 的用量没统计（#9505，见 #9498）：Kimi Code Desktop 1.3.5 换了会话日志格式，主 agent 的用量被跳过，子 agent 的模型显示为 unknown。现在两种格式都能读，不会重复计算；升级后会重新扫描一次旧日志，补上以前漏掉的用量和模型。
  • Antigravity 输出速度虚高（#9858）：4.0.38 起，思考较久的请求能显示几万 tok/s。Antigravity 的输出 token 含隐藏的思考，首字时间也包含思考时长，现在改回按完整耗时计算。
  • T3 Code 和单独运行的 ACP 里的 Antigravity 会话看不到（#9857，见 #9838）：这些会话现在会出现在会话列表和用量统计里。它们没有可用的恢复命令，也不能在 CC Switch 里删除；T3 Code 加在提问外面的说明会去掉，标题显示原本的提问。
  • Mistral 官方 API 开思考后回复为空（见 #9902）：开了思考的 Mistral 官方 API（包括它提供的第三方模型）把回复拆成思考和正文两种片段返回，本地路由读不出来，回复为空或没有思考过程。现在两种片段都能按顺序读出；发给上游的请求不变。
  • Kimi 原生 Responses 在并行看图后一直报 400（#8825，见 #7504）：Codex Desktop 会在并行工具调用的结果之间插入提示，Kimi 这类严格的原生 Responses 上游会丢掉不紧跟调用的结果，这个会话之后每轮都报 400。现在先把这批结果收齐放在一起，再放插入的提示。
  • WorkBuddy 企业账号积分显示为已用完（见 #9694）：企业账号改查企业用量，显示总额度、已用和到期时间；不限量的显示「不限量，已用 N」，查不到额度时报查询失败，不再显示「已用完（共 0）」。
  • 托盘里看不到 xAI 额度（见 #9899）：Codex、Claude Code 里的 xAI OAuth 供应商（包括 Codex 聚合的成员）在托盘里也按绑定的 xAI 账号显示额度，没绑定时用授权中心的默认账号，和主界面卡片一致。
  • 托盘里官方账号显示成网站域名（#9863）：绑了托管账号的 Codex 官方卡，以及 Codex OAuth、GitHub Copilot、xAI OAuth 卡，托盘副标题显示登录的账号（手动备注优先）。主界面的 xAI OAuth 卡片也显示账号；在授权中心登录、切换默认账号、删除或退出登录后托盘会跟着更新。
  • Skills 页的「发现」里出现重复的技能：同一个仓库里末级目录同名的两个技能会装进同一个目录，「发现」里原来显示成两行，现在只显示离仓库根目录最近的那个。
  • OpenCode Desktop 自带的 CLI 被提示用 npm 升级（#9099）：这份 CLI 的安装来源显示为 OpenCode Desktop，并说明它随 Desktop 应用更新，不再计入「全部升级」；单独安装的 OpenCode 照常升级。
  • 快到 64 MiB 上限的流式事件被误跳过（#9867）：4.0.39 加的缓冲上限改成按单条事件判断，接近上限的正常事件不会再和同一块里的下一条一起被丢掉。

升级说明

  • 路由服务监听 0.0.0.0 / ::、又在本机用自定义主机名（不以 .local、.internal、.localhost 结尾）访问路由的，升级后会收到 403，需要在设置「本地路由」的「连接地址」里填上这个主机名（这个地址也会写进各客户端的配置）。局域网、WSL、Docker 里的其他设备不受影响。
  • 会话内容搜索的索引会在升级后第一次搜索时重建，会话多的话第一次会慢一些。

致谢

感谢 @Owlbay（Grok 官方卡绑定 xAI 账号）、@funkpopo（Antigravity 插件、「应用」页版本检查提速、CI 提速、路由 Host 检查）、@YUZHEthefool（安全加固、数据库与路由提速、用量同步提速、会话搜索提速、托盘账号副标题）、@Chenning-Tao（Kimi Code Desktop 用量）、@ZhenWang-BIT（Antigravity 输出速度、T3 Code 会话）、@Fansway（Kimi 并行工具调用）、@teddyli18000（OpenCode Desktop CLI 升级）、@wlndysky（「应用」页冷启动）、@allenxu09（托盘账号副标题、评审修改）、@HaiYangBG1（流式缓冲上限、代码整理）、@SaladDay（测试与代码整理）的贡献。

感谢 @yzw7489757、@Fonsi479、@spy123-1、@Xavier9896、@PorkneckRon、@wintervault、@cxhzzb 报告问题和提供复现信息。

stablyai/orca ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v1.4.272 Stable2026-11-23T12:35:31Z

More reliable bots that pick up where they left off ✨

  • 🤖 Bots recover more reliably after interruptions. Conversations paused by usage limits can continue automatically after an account switch or restart. Resume works for chats interrupted by a crash or restart, and with Resume work on restart enabled, terminal workers can return to their saved conversations even if their terminals were lost. Usage-limit recovery · Chat recovery · Worker recovery
  • 🌐 Use the same browser tools across machines. Extensions such as 1Password now work in SSH workspace tabs and paired-server tabs opened on This device. Drop files from your desktop into server-streamed pages, and let agents on SSH hosts or paired servers upload and download files using paths on their own host. Extensions · Drag and drop · SSH files · Paired-server files
  • 💬 Take a quick detour in chat. On supported agents, type /btw or /side to mark a draft as a side chat. The composer’s worker count now reflects who’s actively working. Side chat · Worker count
  • 💤 Free up idle resources. Memory Saver now unloads hidden This device browser tabs and restores them when you or an agent needs them. An idle WSL distro can stop while Orca stays open and wake when you need it again. Memory Saver · WSL
  • 📱 More room to work from your phone. With the matching mobile build, you can post photos in group rooms, handle agent requests across paired computers from Needs you, and delete chats from an agent’s Chats tab. Group photos · Agent requests · Delete chats

About Orca Bots (Beta) <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/v1.4.272/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="36" height="36" valign="middle" />

  • Resume a failed turn from Slack. A linked Slack thread can offer Resume so you can retry the failed turn and pick up queued work from the thread. Open this thread in Orca also works for bots on paired servers. Resume · Thread links
  • Get replies while workers keep going. Replies on GitHub, Linear, and Discord go out when the turn that wrote them finishes, even if its workers are still running. Reply delivery
  • See what work is waiting on. Items can show Waiting with a reason such as CI, a review, or a deploy. Questions that need your attention still appear in Needs you. Waiting status · Item status display
  • Easier GitHub and Slack setup. GitHub’s Add org and Refresh let you pick an account and rediscover organizations it can already access. Slack setup lets you choose a workspace when there’s more than one. GitHub setup · Slack setup
  • Debug webhook automations faster. Copy a webhook URL from setup, the automation menu, or its page. The CLI counts calls that filters ignored and shows the reason when the server supplies it. Copy URL · Webhook inspection

v1.4.271 Stable2026-11-22T20:13:44Z

Following 1.4.269, here is the next round of Orca. Bots reach Qwen Code and span your paired computers, the phone app manages agents end to end, and chats get lighter and quicker.

Bots across computers, a phone that runs your agents & snappier chats ✨

One bot group can now hold bots from your paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, chats can be deleted and continue on their own after a usage limit, and the phone app can share, import and connect agents without the desktop.

  • 🤖 Bots across computers and agents: One bot group can hold bots from paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, and group rooms hand follow-up turns to every member an agent @mentions.
  • 📱 Run agents from your phone: Edit an agent's automations, connect Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google and Composio, share an agent by link, import one from OpenClaw or Hermes, read its soul and manage its memory and skills, and hand a history session to another agent. These need the matching mobile build.
  • 💬 Calmer chats: Delete a chat, continue after a usage limit by default, list folders in the @ menu, and see quieter rows and a composer that keeps its welcome text clear.
  • 🐧 Steadier Windows and WSL: WSL hosts count working agents for keep-awake, Codex accounts and settings behave on WSL, and moving a folder to a WSL host asks first.
  • ⚡ Lighter all around: Terminal title changes, agent status updates, bot lists and phone refreshes stop rescanning or rebuilding everything, and hidden animations pause.
  • 🐙 More than one GitHub account: Link several GitHub accounts, with leaner link previews and comment polling.

About Orca Bots (Beta) <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="36" height="36" valign="middle" />

Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: they now span your computers, remember what they finished, and pick up where a usage limit or restart cut them off.

  • <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="28" height="28" valign="middle" /> Qwen Code behind your bots: Qwen Code joins the agents a bot can run on.
  • 🖥️ One group, many computers: A bot group can hold bots from paired computers, and an agent's answer to a peer's request shows in the room.
  • 📓 Memory that keeps up: Bots journal each closed item and its PRs, know that work state lives in Items and the journal, and a pilot Tidy-up moves and merges memory lines instead of rewriting them.
  • 🔁 Picks up where it left off: After a restart or a usage-limit pause, bots keep their open requests and continue them once.
  • 💬 Easier replies: Item comment boxes get the composer's mention and slash pickers, and "Replying to" jumps to the question it answers.

Known issue

  • ⚠️ Bots can pause their work: After the app restarts, or after an error such as hitting a usage limit, a bot can stop partway through its work. This will be fixed in the next version.

Coming soon

  • Antigravity bug fixes
  • More connectors
  • Easier moving of bots between different machines
  • More performance improvements
  • Fix bots stall issues under heavy task load
  • Improved PR review workflow
  • More plugin API
  • Sidebar UX improvements

What's Changed

🤖 Bots, connectors & access

Bots can run on Qwen Code and one group can hold bots from paired computers, bots journal closed items and keep requests across restarts and usage-limit pauses, and item comments get the composer's pickers.

v0.9.85 Stable2026-11-23T09:47:32Z

HyperFrames v0.9.85

Released on 2026-11-23.

Apps that embed Studio can now read a sealed preview's page markup. Undo keeps a save made during an import, sealed resizes keep the dragged corner under the pointer, and the skills ask before usage notes or destroy.

Features

  • Studio: Apps embedding Studio can read a sealed preview's page markup (3134c5f1b, #8564).

Fixes

  • Core: A graded video that can no longer be sampled shows plainly instead of freezing (8c31cb3f4, #8570).
  • Studio Server: A save made while an import is taken in keeps its own undo step (773aedef4, #8561).
  • Studio: A sealed save draws in the reply's task and spares a regrab's draft (44c1e0c47, #8563).
  • Skills: Ask before usage notes and destroy, and keep media downloads on public hosts (7f54fded0, #8555).
  • Studio: A sealed resize of a scaled layer keeps its corner on the pointer at rest (75d35bbd8, #8562).
  • Studio: A sealed resize keeps the dragged corner on the pointer at fractional sizes (4f5bfc24c, #8560).
  • Core: A page naming one script in thousands of tags builds once (88295d41f, #8549).
  • Core: A sealed scale resize shows its new scale once saved, not the old one (a50baed34, #8554).

Internal

  • Engine: The browser cache and remote tail tests pass the same on any machine (da7faad39, #8557).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.84...v0.9.85

v0.9.84 Stable2026-11-23T03:15:03Z

HyperFrames v0.9.84

Released on 2026-11-23.

A new blank project opens on an empty timeline again. Leftover render folders are cleaned up reliably on macOS and Windows, and capture finishes on a small host with no GPU.

Fixes

  • Lint: A page with thousands of scripts and tags lints in seconds (148f9deb7, #8551).
  • CLI: Keep objects sliding offscreen in one shot (b734a4114, #8552).
  • Core: A sealed resize keeps a layer centred by a % translate under the pointer (effc9586b, #8547).
  • Studio: A sealed preview that can't swap scenes reloads without asking first (35a0d81c2, #8544).
  • Studio: A new blank project opens on an empty timeline again (e51b75208, #8546).
  • Producer: A dead render's folder is cleaned up reliably, never another machine's (3ee763267, #8538).
  • Studio: A sealed scale resize lands where it was dropped (513dcce82, #8301).
  • Skills: A pasted figma link alone no longer picks the figma skill (f246845ba, #8536).
  • Studio: A sealed resize step draws its offset and size in one message, shipped in v0.9.83 (8521027ff, #8537)

Performance

  • CLI: Capture of an animated page finishes on a small host with no GPU (fff27ce94, #8533).

Internal

  • Studio: Name the draft send by the microtask it waits for (543fcebb9, #8541).
  • A release whose checks fail fails the required Build, so it cannot merge (014e0b0fb, #8543).
  • Studio: The edit bench reads an undo once Studio says its reload is done (07949fb80, #8542).
  • Studio Server: A slow runner no longer leaves index.html's first copy owed in step-ahead tests (cda1b0082, #8540).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.83...v0.9.84

Released on 2026-11-22.

Compiling a page with thousands of clips or style rules stays fast. The notes also list a fix that shipped in v0.9.82: a sandboxed app reads project history again.

Fixes

  • Studio Server: A sandboxed history read no longer fails with EPERM while the app holds it, shipped in v0.9.82 (02450e3e2, #8529)

Performance

  • Producer: Compile time stays linear on pages with thousands of clips or style rules (60c0f9e27, #8528).

Internal

  • CLI: Snapshot, render and check capture skip a held history this run cannot write (0d624100c, #8532).

v0.9.82 Stable2026-11-22T21:40:03Z

HyperFrames v0.9.82

Released on 2026-11-22.

A preview loads GSAP's motion path plugin from the page's own GSAP folder or the host's copy, so it works with no network. Sealed previews get more fixes, from sound and the keyboard to moves inside nested compositions.

Fixes

  • Producer: A render serves every GSAP the CLI ships, and its own when the CDN is blocked (8c9c94572, #8349).
  • Core: The motion path plugin loads from beside the page's own GSAP, never a CDN it did not name (80f45de33, #8523).
  • Producer: A film with many clips of one 4K video no longer freezes the render probe (4daeb78c3, #8284).
  • Studio: A sealed preview never keeps the keyboard, so no key it reports is acted on (196eff39e, #8521).
  • Studio: A turned layer's cropped box is the bounds of its cut corners (e5e360154, #8502).
  • Player: A sealed film is heard when its frame may not start sound (87fddbc1a, #8495).
  • Core: Pasted or written markup never carries a composition source from elsewhere (2425df5f4, #8520).
  • CLI: Pinned-file downloaders check the cache folder is private before reading or writing it (675e3a876, #8486).
  • Studio: Paste and duplicate check the file they write, after every edit to it (bd7a8402d, #8519).
  • CLI: Publish updates a committed project only when this machine linked the folder (886f609c4, #8487).
  • CLI: Print project file names in check's stderr notes as visible escapes (4202462ca, #8485).
  • Player: A late timeline from the old film no longer keeps a switched player ready (c19d98d9a, #8500).
  • Core: A sealed move inside a nested composition shows where it was dropped (ec9a3a8ef, #8517).
  • Studio Server: A page with thousands of script tags no longer stalls the preview (0bc7963ff, #8518).
  • Producer: A probe step's out-of-memory error keeps its words, so it still reads as memory (258a3cf4e, #8513).
  • CLI: Cloudrun and lambda say a usage error before loading their cloud SDK (fbd1cd4bc, #8510).
  • Core: A timeline whose labels throw no longer empties the clip list (5d4420fee, #8512).
  • Studio: Vitest exits when a project is open in the dev data folder (b3d37f948, #8514).
  • Studio: The viewport gate tells a virtualized timeline by its mounted rows, not its clips (dd7799037, #8511).
  • Studio: A cropped layer's outline is cut at the layer's own scale, sealed or not (2b1495f7a, #8496).
  • Core: A far clip whose source is swapped learns its new length (4a47c33ea, #8509).
  • Studio Server: Previewing a page with thousands of media files no longer stalls the app (f03233ab4, #8505).
  • Producer: A render that stops while preparing names the step it stopped in (852611378, #8506).

Internal

  • CLI: The diagnostic test's ffmpeg stand-in answers the demuxer listing, writing no file (f38a4e367, #8515).
  • Studio: A failed walk in the viewport gate job names itself on the check (086948766, #8516).
  • CLI: The sign-in return test waits for each window's navigation instead of one second (20a91dd5f, #8507).

anomalyco/opencode ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v2.4.0 Stable2026-11-23T09:22:21Z

Highlights

  • Built-In Desktop Browser: Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores. Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, your tabs survive restarts and the agent can read and drive the same pages without you switching apps. (#63002, #65073)
  • Automations: Ask the agent to run a prompt, a script or a shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule or when an MCP server sends an event, and manage them with /automation. Set "automations": false in your config if you don't want them. (#65296, #65186)
  • Generate Videos: When a connected provider has a video model, the agent can make videos with generate_video. It keeps working while the video renders and saves the files into your workspace when they're ready. (#63666, #65664)
  • New TUI Look: The TUI's new designs are on by default, and the opencode theme is the new one. Pick opencode-classic in Theme to keep the previous colors. (#64988)
  • Windows Taskbar Status: On Windows, the taskbar button shows session progress, counts sessions that need you and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. (#65317, #65318, #65319)

Upgrade notes

  • Image tool renamed. experimental_image_generate is now generate_image. Permission rules with the old name are mapped automatically, but saved "always allow" approvals are not, so it asks again once. (#65682)
  • Plugins that follow a version now update on their own. A plugin written as name@latest, a version range (such as name@^1.2.0), a Git branch or a Git semver: range is checked on startup and every 24 hours, and a newer match is installed and reloaded. Ranges never leave their range, and if a new version fails to load the previous one keeps running. A bare name, an exact version, another tag such as @next, a Git tag or a commit hash doesn't update itself; opencode plugin update still updates those by hand. (#64764, #65052, #65056)
  • GitHub Copilot no longer reads GITHUB_TOKEN. Set COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN or sign in with OAuth. (#64697)
  • MCP servers are tried on the newest protocol first. A server without a protocol setting is probed before falling back to the legacy handshake. Set protocol: "legacy" on a server that misbehaves. (#65282)
  • The TUI opencode theme changed. It now means the new theme; set opencode-classic for the previous look, and experimental["new-designs"]: false in your TUI config for the previous designs. (#64988)
  • Chat links open in the browser pane. In the desktop app, web links from the chat open beside the conversation. Modifier-click a link to open it in your system browser. A browser deny in your permission rules refuses every agent browser call. (#63002)
  • OpenCode Go connects through OpenCode. The connect dialogs and opencode auth login list one OpenCode option that includes Go models. OpenCode Go is only listed when a Go key is already saved, and saved keys keep working. (#65466)
  • New desktop shortcut. Cmd+Shift+S (Ctrl+Shift+S on Windows and Linux) now archives the open session. The composer's Cmd+U and Escape/Ctrl+G now follow the Attach file and Stop session shortcuts. (#65428, #64394)
  • Code Mode session tool paths moved. tools.opencode.session_rename and session_move are now tools.opencode.session.rename and .move. Direct tool names and permission actions are unchanged. (#65080)
  • TUI plugins need OpenTUI 0.9.4. @opencode/plugin requires @opentui/core and @opentui/solid 0.9.4 or later. Renderers passed to registerCodeBlockRenderer now receive an OpenTUI block (block.text) instead of a Markdown token; codeBlockStyle and escaped are gone. (#63989)
  • SDK: plugins load in the background again. Plugins are meant to load asynchronously, and the server never waits for them. In v2.2.7 the model, provider, generate.*, voice.* and websearch.query endpoints started waiting up to 5 seconds for plugins and returning 503 after that (#63040); this release removes that wait. Right after startup these endpoints answer with whatever has loaded, so a list can be empty or partial. Long-lived clients should refresh on the matching *.updated event, such as model.updated. One-shot scripts should wait on their side, for example by polling plugin.list until it returns plugins, or the endpoint until the entry they need appears. (#63814)
  • Desktop voice needs a matching server. The app reads each voice model's engine, which older servers don't report, so voice shows as unavailable against a server from before this release. (#65506)
  • Storage write path. Assistant parts are now saved as their own rows. experimental.part_rows: false restores the old path for this release. (#65039)

Core

Improvements

  • Added automations. Agents can schedule prompts, Code Mode scripts or fixed shell commands to run once, on an interval, on a cron schedule or when a connected MCP server pushes an event. Use the /automation command or the automation tools. A shell action asks for approval once, when it's created, and records each run's exit code and output. Set "automations": false to turn them off. (#65296, #65186, #65217, #65236, #65001, #65699)
  • MCP Events shipped: OpenCode follows the MCP Events beta for push delivery, with argument checks, heartbeats and automatic reconnects. An event too large for its prompt is skipped and its automation keeps running. (#65271, #65673)
  • MCP servers without a protocol setting now negotiate the newest MCP protocol and fall back to the legacy handshake. (#65282)
  • Agents can generate videos with generate_video whenever a connected provider has a video model. The job runs in the background, survives a server restart, saves the finished videos into the workspace and wakes the agent with their paths. Set a default model with experimental.video_generate.model. The image tool is now called generate_image. (#63666, #64546, #65664, #65682)
  • Plugins that follow a version (name@latest, a version range, a Git branch or a Git semver: range) are checked on startup and every 24 hours, and a newer match is installed and reloaded without a restart. A range stays within its range, and if a new version fails to load, the previous one keeps running. Other plugins still only report updates. (#64764, #65052, #65056)
  • The Claude Agent provider has a configDir setting for a Claude config folder other than the default. Given a list of folders, a chat moves to the next account when one hits its usage limit. Claude Agent sessions also show up in Claude Code as coming from opencode. (#62514, #65035, #65016)
  • Removing a Sign in with ChatGPT account, with opencode auth logout or the remove button in the app, now also revokes it with OpenAI. (#64947)
  • The ChatGPT plan model lists now come from models.dev, so new models show up without an OpenCode update. (#65579)
  • Voice models are now listed from models.dev, adding newer OpenAI models such as gpt-live-1.1. (#65491)
  • Reading far into a large file with read, or reading its tail, takes far fewer reads, which is much faster on remote workspaces. (#65611)
  • The shell tool's result says why a command ended without an exit code, and lists its output after the smaller fields so they survive truncation. (#65365, #65513)
  • Code Mode scripts can define getters and setters, errors have a stack showing where they were thrown, and a failed import says why. (#64908, #64939, #64587)
  • A timeout set on a provider now applies to every request, including image, video, speech, transcription, embedding and compaction requests, which previously could hang forever on a stalled provider. (#64692)
  • Gemma 4 models on Google's Interactions API offer the none and thinking variants, and the provider's safetySettings are sent to Interactions. (#65038, #65036)
  • Added claude-agent as a web search provider. With Claude Agent connected, set "websearch": { "provider": "claude-agent" } to run websearch through Claude Code's WebSearch, which Claude plans include, so any model can search without a search API key. (#65704)
  • With full_codemode on, agents can call tools.opencode.session.interrupt to stop another session, its background jobs and its subagents. (#65718)
  • Stored blobs, such as generated videos, are deleted a week after they were written, so the data folder no longer grows without limit. Copies saved into your project are untouched; GET /api/experimental/blob/:id returns 404 for a deleted blob. (#65671)
  • Config now reloads only when a file that feeds it changes, not on every write under .opencode such as editing a skill. (#62158)
  • Each streamed assistant part is saved as its own row instead of rewriting the whole message on every update, so long steps with many tool calls save reliably. (#65039)

Bug fixes

  • Fixed GitHub Copilot picking up GITHUB_TOKEN, which git tooling and GitHub Actions often set without Copilot access. It now reads COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN. (#64697)
  • Fixed shell commands the scanner can't analyze, such as dynamic execution, failing outright. They now ask for permission, and a matching shell deny rule still blocks them. (#65269)
  • Fixed sessions getting stuck on provider 400 errors after a model called a tool by a dotted name such as a Code Mode path. A Code Mode tool called at the top level now runs as that tool, with a note telling the model to use execute. (#65292, #65193, #65494)
  • Fixed a forced tool choice for a namespaced tool naming a tool the request never declared on every provider except native OpenAI Responses. (#65621, #65726)
  • Fixed the shell tool's description not saying which OS and shell commands run in when full_codemode is on. (#65712)
  • Fixed a revoked or expired ChatGPT sign-in failing every prompt with "Request failed: 400". It now asks you to connect again. (#65289)
  • Fixed edit and patch replacing every non-UTF-8 character (Latin-1, cp1252, GBK…) with � across the whole file. They now refuse to rewrite such files. (#64868)
  • Fixed the review pane showing every line as changed in repositories with core.autocrlf=true, and symlinks as modified with core.symlinks=false. (#64884)
  • Fixed file permission rules not matching other capitalizations of the same path on macOS. Thanks @knp-sap. (#64626)
  • Fixed the model picker staying empty while a slow project was still loading. (#63814)
  • Fixed Claude Agent processes staying alive after their session was deleted. Thanks @WTLAIB. (#62649)
  • Fixed Claude Agent models becoming unavailable after Claude Code renamed them, and Claude Agent now waits up to 60 seconds for its process to start. (#65032, #65064)
  • Fixed shell commands failing with "failed to open output file" after OpenCode's shell output directory was removed. (#64889)
  • Fixed concurrent shell commands failing on Windows with PowerShell 7 from the Microsoft Store, and stopping one such command killing the others. (#64901)
  • Fixed opencode service set password writing the password to the CLI log. (#64911)
  • Fixed opencode run hanging when a FIFO is passed as an attachment; it's now rejected right away. Thanks @yang0228. (#64696)
  • Fixed opencode <name> crashing with a stack trace when <name> is neither a command nor a directory. It now prints help and the error. (#65262)
  • Fixed the background service becoming unresponsive at startup with a large database write-ahead log on a slow disk. (#64532)
  • Fixed a client that opens a session during a running tool call not seeing that tool's progress, such as a running subagent's session. (#64929)
  • Fixed Markdown commands dropping a separate variant next to model, and agents being skipped when frontmatter repair turned inline lists or objects into strings. (#65118, #65119)
  • Fixed Google Interactions responses stopping early when Google splits a response across requests. (#65006)
  • Fixed GPT models over OpenAI's WebSocket transport resending the whole conversation after a freeform tool call such as execute or patch. (#64706)
  • Fixed gpt-6.2-astra and later Astra models getting a 500k context window with ChatGPT sign-in; they stay at 272k. (#64725)
  • OpenAI cyber_policy and Gemini "terms of use" refusals are now reported as content policy errors. Thanks @lu-zero. (#64844, #64910)
  • Fixed MiniMax text-to-video requests without an aspect ratio being rejected; they now default to 16:9. (#64822)
  • Fixed several Code Mode built-ins to match Bun: localeCompare and Date toLocale* honor their locale and options, toBase64/fromBase64 honor their options, Buffer map, filter, slice and subarray return a Buffer, and Uint8Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT is defined. (#64935, #64938, #64931, #64933, #64930, #64965)
  • Fixed large file views not refreshing when only the end of the file changed. (#65114)
  • Fixed the install script failing with a disk-space error when curl is installed through Snap. (#65132)

TUI

Improvements

  • The new TUI designs are on by default, and the theme named opencode is the new theme. The previous default is available as opencode-classic, and opencode2 keeps working as an alias of opencode. To go back to the previous designs, turn off New designs in the Experiments dialog. (#64988)
  • /login and /auth open the same dialog as /connect, which now lists a single OpenCode entry that includes OpenCode Go models. (#65265, #65466)
  • Pressing ↓ opens the picker on the first tab with something running, the same tab that clicking the footer opens. (#64972)
  • Text prompt dialogs such as rename session, /btw, worktree names and connect forms end with a Submit button, and prompt and export dialogs have tighter spacing. (#64944)
  • The opencode theme's light mode uses lighter grays for the prompt box, selected tabs and hovered rows. (#64962)

Bug fixes

  • Fixed connect forms built from integration fields, such as the Azure resource name, showing an empty row between the title and the input. (#64944)
  • Fixed list dialogs ending with two blank rows, and the Manage workspaces footer not staying at the bottom. (#64983)
  • Fixed long dialog lists replacing their last visible row with a stray …. (#64934)
  • Fixed the selection bar of a delete-confirmation row staying blue instead of red. (#64936)
  • Fixed file, agent and skill mentions landing on the wrong text when you restore a prompt sent from the desktop or web app that contains tabs or wide characters. (#63989)

Desktop

Improvements

  • The browser pane keeps you signed in. Links from the chat open beside the conversation in one saved profile, you can import sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and other browsers, and you can install store extensions after reviewing what they can access. The pane gains a right-click menu, find in page, page dialogs, permission prompts, pop-up blocking and readable error pages, and the address bar completes from your history. The agent can read and drive the same signed-in tabs. (#63002, #65073)
  • New tabs that a page opens in the browser pane appear beside the tab they came from, and middle-clicking a link opens it in a new tab. (#65126, #65091)
  • Comments in the browser pane, file viewer and review diff can be sent to the session right away with Mod+Enter. Depending on your follow-up setting, they send, steer or queue. (#65264)
  • Added Wrap code blocks under Settings › General › Timeline, plus a Wrap lines button on timeline code blocks with lines too long to fit. (#64545, #64576)
  • Added Keep side panel open across sessions in Settings › General. (#64950)
  • Added an Archive session command, bound to Cmd+Shift+S (Ctrl+Shift+S on Windows and Linux). (#65428)
  • The Home session menu has Open and Open in background, and Home shows the provider connect hint when nothing is connected. (#65209, #65212, #64885)
  • The Inbox layout's sidebar has a Drafts group for unsent new-session drafts. (#65525)
  • Conversation search (Cmd+F / Ctrl+F) has previous and next match buttons. (#64865)
  • The connect dialog lists one OpenCode option that includes OpenCode Go models, Settings › Providers follows the same rule, and the free model picker has a tighter layout. (#65466, #65740, #64927)
  • When you reach your ChatGPT Business workspace's usage limit, a dialog explains it and offers Copy request for admin. (#64926)
  • Voice uses the newest GPT-Live model the server lists. (#65506)
  • Shortcuts go through the same keymap engine as the TUI, and the new Stop session command can be changed in Settings › Shortcuts. (#64394)
  • Shortcuts can be key chords, such as Mod+K Mod+C or G I. In Settings › Shortcuts, click + on a shortcut you just recorded to add another key, up to 4. While a chord is pending, a panel lists the keys that continue it. (#64395)
  • The activity pill keeps a subagent listed while work it started is still running. (#64790)
  • The goal pill has a new design with the labels Following goal, Goal paused and Goal reached. (#60001)
  • Keyboard focus shows as one consistent ring across the app, no longer appears after a mouse click, and moves to the next item when the focused one is removed. The timeline and the composer no longer draw a ring around their whole frame. (#64909, #64976, #65082, #65084, #65100, #65690)
  • Only the latest response shows its Copy button all the time; older ones show it on hover or focus. (#64640)
  • Added experimental tab groups for side tabs under Settings › Experimental. (#64407)
  • On Windows, the taskbar button shows session status as a progress bar, a count badge for sessions that need you, and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. Notifications say what is being asked and disappear once you answer. (#65317, #65318, #65319, #65325, #65421)
  • On Windows, the jump list has New Session and New Window, you can drag files from the file tree into other apps, and Open in includes Windows Terminal and lists only installed apps. (#65327, #65330, #65320)
  • The web app can be built to run under a path prefix, for example behind a reverse proxy, with bun --cwd packages/app build --base=/opencode/. (#64597)
  • The background activity menu stays smooth with many subagents, and the model picker stays responsive with catalogs of thousands of models. (#65634, #65189, #65635)

Bug fixes

  • Fixed opencode://open-project and opencode://new-session links doing nothing. (#65332)
  • Fixed file links like ~/Downloads/clip.mp4 showing "File not found". ~ now opens in the server's home folder. (#65689)
  • Fixed an open session's side panel tabs disappearing after you had used many other sessions. (#65328, #65322)
  • Fixed the app freezing when opening a session on a remote server with Share sign-ins with remote servers on. (#65339)
  • Fixed the app freezing for several seconds when you open a group of long Code Mode scripts. An Execute row now lists its latest 10 calls, with +N more for the earlier ones. (#65696)
  • Fixed the browser pane showing "The browser couldn't open" in a project whose server had only just started. (#65720)
  • Fixed Clear browsing data clearing everything on the first click; it now asks first. (#65124)
  • Fixed browser tabs showing a generic globe instead of the site's icon, saved tabs appearing late after the app reopens, and the page going blank while a panel is resized on Windows. (#65094, #65067, #65083)
  • Fixed sites in the browser pane replacing the app's badge on the taskbar or Dock. (#65646)
  • Fixed the mouse Back and Forward buttons doing nothing. (#65129)
  • Fixed a subagent's pending permission request not reappearing after a reload or reconnect. (#65120)
  • Fixed background jobs that changed while the job list was loading showing the wrong state, and rows in the activity menu jumping around. (#64966, #65312)
  • Fixed the session view crashing when a timeline row disappeared mid-update. (#64565)
  • Fixed earlier replies being folded into the "Used N tools" group when a session was woken without a new message. (#64917)
  • Fixed the Context tab showing the latest instruction update as the "System Prompt". (#64991)
  • Fixed the session header briefly showing the wrong worktree while a new session starts. (#65190)
  • Fixed Grep, Glob and List rows showing the parent of the folder they searched, and Windows paths not showing relative to the project. (#65460, #65639)
  • Fixed server event streams going stale after Windows wakes from sleep, and windows reopening in the wrong place after being snapped or minimized. (#65321, #65323)
  • Fixed the Windows caption buttons being hard to see with a contrast theme. (#65324)
  • Fixed Open in PowerShell on Windows opening Windows PowerShell instead of PowerShell 7 when it's installed. (#64873)
  • Fixed builds packaged without app-update.yml, such as AUR packages, showing update-check errors. Settings now shows Updates unavailable. (#64681)
  • Fixed the message menu's "Today" and "Yesterday" labels, and Home's date headers staying invisible while scrolling. (#65081, #64665)
  • Fixed clipped or misleading focus rings, the side panel's add button being skipped by Tab, and the Compacted label only partly highlighting on hover. (#65215, #65192, #65176, #65177, #65211, #65213, #65644)
  • Fixed the Hex voice tip showing on phones and tablets, and a fringe on project icon corners. (#64583, #64582)

SDK

Improvements

  • Added experimental.job.cancel to cancel a running background job, and an experimental.job.updated event when a job starts, moves to the background or ends. @opencode/client/solid's createData has a job slice. (#64790, #65266, #64956)
  • The video endpoints (experimental.generate.video.create and .get) no longer need a flag. Video jobs survive a server restart, can return more than one video, and stay readable for 24 hours after they finish. (#65664, #64546)
  • The automation endpoints work without a flag, and an automation can run a shell command as its action. (#65296, #65186)

Extensions

Improvements

  • A plugin tool can set options.codemode to an object ({ pinned?, description?, input?, output? }) to give its Code Mode form its own description and schemas. Top-level options.pinned still works but is deprecated. (#64515)
  • The execute.before and execute.after tool hooks receive info, the tool's definition, and codemode, which is true when a Code Mode script made the call. (#64515)
  • An integration's OAuth method can define revoke to sign a credential out remotely before it's removed. (#64947)
  • TUI plugins can read a session's running background jobs with api.data.job.list(sessionID) (experimental). (#64956)
  • experimental.idle background entries can have the kind video. (#63666)
  • GUI plugins can declare their own SVG icons with Plugin.define({ icons }) and use them through ctx.icons. The built-in outline-pair and outline-steer icons were removed. (#64577)
  • The GUI composer API adds composer.send(commentID) and composer.delivery(), and the Browser contract adds experimental.open and experimental.close. (#65264, #63002)
  • GUI System.open only launches HTTP, HTTPS and mail URLs, and Browser.open refuses file:// URLs outside the built-in preview. (#63002)
